statement.zh: Estrada-Belli：古典期由公元 3 世纪早期雕刻王室纪念碑开启；本条止于早古典开端。
statement.en: Estrada-Belli: the Classic is inaugurated by early carved royal monuments in the 3rd century CE; this entry stops at Early Classic onset.
